body.dataset: DVSA vehicle safety recalls — bulk download (RecallsFile.csv, "all recalls since 1992")
body.publisher: Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (DVSA), Vehicle Safety Branch — GOV.UK
body.attributionNote: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 — DVSA safety recall notices as published (texts unedited); a citation, not an endorsement by DVSA or any manufacturer. Recall counts are not a reliability measure (sales volume, multi-model campaigns).

recalls.concern: BCM software missing telltale if LKA unavailable
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles the Lane Keep Assist tell-tale fails to illuminate if the front camera is blocked meaning no warning light appears in the instrument cluster.
recalls.remedy: Update the Body Control Module software.

recalls.concern: Alternator protection
recalls.defect: Affected vehicles may have been assembled with contact or with a reduced clearance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. There is a possibility of contact between these components leading to water infiltration and an electrical arch which could trigger a thermal event.
recalls.remedy: Replace the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator. Check the distance between the Gasoline Particulate Filter pipe and the pole protection cap of the 48V Belt Starter Generator and re‑position or replace the pipe if required.

recalls.concern: Vauxhall Corsa Mokka Combo ESC software
recalls.defect: Affected vehicles may have incorrect or missing tyre pressure messages displayed in the instrument cluster due to a software deviation.
recalls.remedy: Update the Electric Stability Control calibration to ensure the correct tyre pressure warning messages are displayed

recalls.concern: Autonomous Telematics Box
recalls.defect: Affected vehicles have been fitted with the wrong Autonomous Telematic Box. This means it cannot connect to the remoter server making it impossible to make E-Calls or use Intelligent Speed Assistance.
recalls.remedy: Replace the Autonomous Telematic Box.

recalls.concern: Emission recall – On Board Diagnostics
recalls.defect: Vehicles may be affected by incorrect performance of the On-Board-Diagnostics related to Selective Catalytic Reduction system and/or Diesel Particle Filter. The Malfunction Indicator Light (MIL) may not illuminate in the event of a malfunction and therefore does not comply with emission regulations.
recalls.remedy: Update the Engine Control Unit software to ensure compliance to regulations.

recalls.concern: Vauxhall Fuel Pipe
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles there there may be loose connections between a high-pressure fuel pipe and the engine fuel rail which potentially could lead to a leak and risk of fire.
recalls.remedy: Retighten the affected connections.

recalls.concern: Vauxhall DV5R Engines Camshaft Chain.
recalls.defect: Vehicles may be affected by premature wearing of the camshaft drive chain leading to abnormal noise or to a breakage of the chain in the worst case.
recalls.remedy: Update the software to improve oil pressure and reduce wear. Check the engine noise and replace the chain if required. If no problem found change the oil to one with higher viscosity and special anti-wear additives.

recalls.concern: Autonomous Telematics Box
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles the Autonomous Telematics Box (ATB) has no connectivity to the Connected Services features and therefore does not comply with regulatory requirements.
recalls.remedy: Replace the ATB to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

recalls.concern: Brake Pressure Modulator Valve
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles the Electronic Brake System Module is not according to specification which could potentially lead to light internal leakage of brake fluid.
recalls.remedy: Replace the Electronic Brake System Module.

recalls.concern: Traction Battery software
recalls.defect: Affected vehicles may face an error in the Battery Monitoring Unit software.
recalls.remedy: Update the Battery Monitoring Unit software.

recalls.concern: Autonomous Telematics Box failure after OTA update.
recalls.defect: Affected vehicles may have been equipped with an Autonomous Telematic Box (ATB) which does not work.
recalls.remedy: Change the ATB.

recalls.concern: Vauxhall Corsa Jet cooling nozzle failure.
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles the engine is at risk of becoming damaged because of an inadequate oil supply from an oil jet cooling nozzle.
recalls.remedy: Replace the engine oil and filter.

recalls.concern: Vauxhall Automomous Telematics Box.
recalls.defect: Affected vehicles may experience an autonomous telematic box that cannot connect to the remote server making it not possible to make calls or use other connected services.
recalls.remedy: Disconnect the 12V battery and reconnect it after 15 seconds then check for a trouble code.

recalls.concern: Vauxhall Astra Corsa Mokka eVCU update
recalls.defect: Affected vehicles may not comply with test requirements in the matter of emissions test execution by competent authorities and energy consumption may be too high.
recalls.remedy: Update the electrical Vehicle Control Unit (eVCU) software.

recalls.concern: Vauxhall Corsa Radio software via OTA update.
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) functionality may not meet regulatory requirements and the Active Emergency Brake (AEB) and Lane Keep Assist (LKA) can inadvertently be deactivated by a long press of the ADAS button on the radio.
recalls.remedy: On the affected vehicles the radio software will be updated by an Over-The-Air update which will be remotely checked as successfully installed.

recalls.concern: Vauxhall Corsa D Passenger Airbag
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles the passenger front airbag may not deploy properly in the event of a collision.
recalls.remedy: On affected vehicles the passenger front air bag will be replaced.

recalls.concern: Vauxhall Corsa F- Evaporation test results on EB2FA engines.
recalls.defect: Affected vehicles may exceed regulatory emission standards
recalls.remedy: Replace the canister purge valve (CPV) and or fuel line.

recalls.concern: MCU software
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles incorrect MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration may result in a loss of propulsion while driving.
recalls.remedy: Update the MCU (Motor Control Unit) calibration

recalls.concern: Cross carline Engine software
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles below 12500 miles under certain conditions engine emissions may lead to a non-compliance to regulatory requirements.
recalls.remedy: Check the mileage of the vehicle and update the ECU (Engine Control Unit) calibration on vehicles below 12500 miles.

recalls.concern: Vauxhall Corsa F Rear axle
recalls.defect: Affected vehicles may have been built with a rear axle not properly welded.
recalls.remedy: Check the rear axle assembly and replace it if necessary.

recalls.concern: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles the AC compressor stator wiring could develop a fault leading to current loss inside the AC compressor that could result in a vehicle powertrain shutdown when driving.
recalls.remedy: Reprogram the Powertrain Diagnosis ECU with updated software.

recalls.concern: There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving.
recalls.defect: There is an error in the software calibration of the traction battery control unit which could result in a loss of propulsion when driving.
recalls.remedy: Update the software of the traction battery control unit.

recalls.concern: SOFTWARE DOES NOT ALLOW CONFORMITY TESTING
recalls.defect: Software does not allow the authorities to test according to regulation.
recalls.remedy: Re-flash the Body Control software.

recalls.concern: THE CUSTOMER MIGHT NOT BE ALERTED TO A MALFUNCTION OF THE TURN INDICATOR
recalls.defect: The customer might not be alerted to a malfunction of the turn indicator.
recalls.remedy: Update the Built-in System Interface (BSI) module with new software.

recalls.concern: A POTENTIAL FOR AN INTERMITTENT INTERNAL CONNECTION ISSUE ON THE DC/DC CHIP OF THE ON-BOARD CHARGER
recalls.defect: A potential for an intermittent internal connection issue on the DC/DC chip of the on-board charger.
recalls.remedy: Check and if necessary replace the on-board charger and update with the latest software.

recalls.concern: POSSIBLE UNEXPECTED SIDE AIRBAG DEPLOYMENT DUE TO INSUFFICIENT ELECTRICAL GROUNDING
recalls.defect: Possible unexpected side airbag deployment due to insufficient electrical grounding.
recalls.remedy: Rework the affected ground studs to ensure sufficient electrical grounding.

recalls.concern: SEATBELTS MAY STICK WHEN PULLED OUT OR RETRACTED
recalls.defect: On affected vehicles certain seat belts might stick when pulled out and retracted.
recalls.remedy: Replace the affected seat belts on the affected vehicles.

recalls.concern: THE LAMBDA CONTROL MIGHT NOT BE ROBUST/PRECISE ENOUGH AT HIGH SPEED
recalls.defect: lambda control may result in NOx limit being exceeded during the vehicle lifetime.
recalls.remedy: An engine management system software upgrade will be installed.

recalls.concern: MODEL MAY BE AFFECTED BY UNEXPECTED OPENING OF THE HOOD WHILE DRIVING
recalls.defect: Unexpected opening of the hood while driving.
recalls.remedy: Check operation and repair if required.

recalls.concern: HANDBRAKE MAY DISENGAGE
recalls.defect: Due to a possible contamination of the tooth segment the handbrake pawl may not latch correctly. This may cause the handbrake to disengage.
recalls.remedy: On affected vehicles Replace the parking brake lever assembly.

recalls.concern: ROOF SIDE RAIL AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY INCORRECTLY
recalls.defect: A roof side rail air bag may not deploy as intended
recalls.remedy: On affected vehicles replace the airbag module assembly

recalls.concern: STEERING RACK MAY FRACTURE
recalls.defect: Due to a manufacturing process deviation the toothed rack of the steering gear might break under extensive force application i.e. when manoeuvring at slow speed.
recalls.remedy: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the build date of the steering rack. Where the steering rack is proved to be from the affected batch the steering rack will be replaced.

recalls.concern: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR
recalls.defect: There is the possibility of water penetration into the vent hose resulting in water ingress into the vacuum pump over the wire harness and into the relay box. In the worst case a short circuit may lead to a risk of fire.
recalls.remedy: On affected vehicles add a spray deflector to avoid water ingress into the vent hose replace the electronic vacuum pump/relay box assembly and apply special grease to the electrical terminals.

recalls.concern: RISK OF FIRE
recalls.defect: Water ingress to the relay on the electrical vacuum pump may cause a short. In extreme instances this may lead to fire.
recalls.remedy: On affected vehicles replace Vacuum Pump/Relay Assembly and apply special grease to electrical connectors

body.matching: exact = the recall's model name equals yours after normalisation (case, accents, punctuation ignored); text = your model string appears as a whole word inside the recall's model name (so "corsa" also matches "CORSA D" and "CORSA-e", never "CORSAVAN"). A make query also covers DVSA's product-line entries for that brand (e.g. "mercedes" includes MERCEDES-BENZ VANS); makeNamesInSource lists the published make strings behind the slug.

notes.vehiclesAffected: DVSA records the recall total against each model row (occasionally a per-model figure); vehiclesAffected is the largest figure among the model rows shown, so a multi-model recall is not this model's share.
notes.link: link opens the GOV.UK recall checker at make / model / build year, which lists this recall among any others for that year.

definitions.supported: true while the cycle has not reached its eol date (or has no eol date set) as of asOf; security fixes are still published
definitions.eol: end of life — the date security updates stop under standard support, as endoflife.date records it from the vendor; null when no date is set
definitions.activeSupportEnds: end of active (feature and bug-fix) support; after it a supported cycle receives security fixes only; null when not tracked
definitions.extendedSupportEnds: end of the vendor's extended or paid support where one exists (Ubuntu Pro, Debian LTS/ELTS, Windows ESU, Oracle extended support)
definitions.lts: long-term-support cycle as of asOf (Node.js cycles become LTS on ltsFrom)
definitions.latest: latest release in the cycle at the snapshot (verifiedDate); a newer patch may exist since
